name: 115. OpenAI GPT-6 compatibility stack (Astra / Sol / Luna)
description:
Live regression coverage for the GPT-6 compatibility stack.

115.1/115.2 pin Astra's always-reasoning fallback on both OpenAI request converters: caller effort none becomes low, and sampling/logprob fields that Astra rejects are removed from the outbound body.
115.3/115.4 pin the inverse for the newly released Sol and Luna models. Both can disable reasoning, so none must survive; the requests include forced function calling because Chat tool use on these models depends on reasoning being disabled.
115.5 covers the GPT-6 max-effort ladder and the prompt-cache translation added for the family: cache_control becomes prompt_cache_breakpoint and opts the request into explicit cache mode.
115.6/115.7 are a real async-tool chain. The first response must return async on its function_call; the second replays that pending call without a tool output. Dropping async on replay makes OpenAI reject the request with "No tool output found for function call".
115.8 proves async is retained only on the supported function/custom tool kinds when they are mixed with another tool.

Every shaping assertion reads extra_fields.raw_request via x-bf-send-back-raw-request, so these rows verify what Bifrost sent rather than inferring it from a 2xx response.
